description.value: Naked Naturals Whole Foods & Supplements is a nearly 4,000 sq ft independent organic market that has served the Qualicum Beach area since 2011, offering produce, dairy, meat, deli, grocery, and vitamin/supplement departments. The store is committed to certified organic and FairTrade products, sourcing from small local Vancouver Island farms whenever possible. A front patio welcomes visitors for coffee or a baked good in the heart of downtown Qualicum Beach.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, open organic grocery store operating as 'Naked Naturals Whole Foods & Supplements' — the OSM name 'Naked Wholesale' is a mismatch. Critically, the website shows the Qualicum Beach address as '#101 – 671 Fir Street', not '122 Second Avenue East' as in OSM, consistent with the URL discovery note that the store may have relocated. No bike parking, water refill, or most optional amenities are mentioned on the website; basic groceries are confirmed by explicit department listings (produce, dairy, meat, deli, grocery, supplements).
concerns: OSM name 'Naked Wholesale' does not match the business's own name 'Naked Naturals Whole Foods & Supplements' / 'Naked Naturals Whole Foods Ltd.'
OSM address '122 Second Avenue East' does not match the website address '#101 – 671 Fir Street, Qualicum Beach' — store appears to have relocated; OSM record may be stale or a duplicate node.
URL discovery notes flagged 'Duplicate OSM node; store may have relocated' — the OSM record at 122 Second Avenue East may be a phantom/outdated entry.
About Us page states Qualicum Beach location opened April 2009, while the location page states April 2011 — minor internal inconsistency on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active organic grocery store with a confirmed web presence and clear product offerings useful to touring cyclists. Address and name discrepancies are flagged but do not indicate the business is closed or non-existent.
enrichment_extras.notes: Phone number (250) 594-0277 is from the website (Qualicum Beach line); OSM had no phone on record. Website address used in preference to OSM address per rule 12, as the website clearly shows a different and current location.

wow_evidence: independent organic market that has served the Qualicum Beach area since 2011
